description: Source code for a Wear OS watch face service that displays user's daily distance total via Google Fit API, including GoogleApiClient setup, distance data retrieval, and rendering logic.

classes.name: FitDistanceWatchFaceService
classes.description: A service that provides a watch face displaying user's daily distance from Google Fit.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, managing Google Fit API connection, data retrieval, and rendering.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles registration of receiver and GoogleApiClient connection based on visibility.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout and text sizes for round or square watches.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Adjusts anti-aliasing based on device properties.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Updates distance data and redraws on each tick.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws time and distance on the canvas.

methods.name: getTotalDistance
methods.description: Requests total distance from Google Fit API if not already requested.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles successful connection to Google Fit, subscribes to distance data, and fetches total distance.

methods.name: subscribeToDistance
methods.description: Subscribes to distance delta updates from Google Fit.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Processes the total distance result from Google Fit API.
